Live and replay links to a session's browsers for an outside app.

## Embed a session's browser

`POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/browsers/{browserSessionId}/embed` (SDK method `embedBrowserSession`)

A link for an iframe: a watch-only live view of one of the session's open browsers, or a replay of one, open or closed. Needs viewer on the session; never an agent. The link carries a short-lived token scoped to that one view (never control), lasting `minutes`. A closed browser has no live view (`expired`); a deployment whose browsers keep no recordings has no replay (`unavailable`), and a recording past its retention is `expired`. Audited as `browser.session.embedded`, without the link.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | yes | The session's ID. |
| `browserSessionId` | string | yes | The browser session's ID, as the session's browser tool items name it. |

**Body**: [EmbedBrowserBody](/api/reference/types/#embedbrowserbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [BrowserEmbed](/api/reference/types/#browserembed) (`application/json`). The link to frame.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `410` expired, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
